routes.title: The Plan Got Resized
routes.truth: Some couples do not cancel the plan; they resize it until both moods fit.
routes.obstacle: She wants movement and outside air; he wants rest and almost-home.
routes.proof: Keys move, shoes arrive, blanket resists, door opens halfway, the plan shrinks to building-gate distance.
routes.aachu_role: She wants bahar without becoming a nag; she lets the full plan become smaller.
routes.zuv_role: He wants bistar without dismissing her; he gets up and chooses the smallest real outside.
routes.reversal: The win is not that one person gets their plan. The win is that the plan becomes livable for both.

routes.title: One Shoe Outside
routes.truth: Some outings begin with one person still emotionally in bed.
routes.obstacle: He wants to be the person who comes along, but his body is still in rest mode.
routes.proof: He reaches the doorway with one sneaker and one home slipper.
routes.aachu_role: She laughs and makes the outing smaller instead of shaming him.
routes.zuv_role: He moves toward her world in the funniest possible half-ready way.
routes.reversal: The half-ready joke becomes proof that he still came.

routes.title: She Wanted Outside. He Wanted Almost Home.
routes.truth: Love is sometimes the tiny middle between outside and bed.
routes.obstacle: A full outing is too much for him; staying in is too little for her.
routes.proof: They settle for stairs, gate, or a nearby bench.
routes.aachu_role: She keeps her need for air visible.
routes.zuv_role: He does not make her feel silly for wanting outside.
